description: This file defines the MessageConfig interface in Java, providing configuration settings related to message timeouts within the gateway service, including default and maximum timeout values, along with an internal enum for known config values.

classes.name: MessageConfig
classes.description: An interface providing access to message-related configuration settings, specifically default and maximum timeout durations, for the messages resource within the gateway.

classes.name: MessageConfig.MessageConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration that implements KnownConfigValue, representing known configuration path expressions and their default values for message timeouts.

methods.name: getDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout duration for claim messages initiated via the /messages resource.

methods.name: getMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout duration permitted for claim messages initiated via the /messages resource.
